title: Account-protected planner
notes: Changed: Google sign-in is now required before the planner opens, so every active planner belongs to an isolated account profile.
Safe migration: Move existing phone data into the account, use an existing cloud planner, or deliberately start empty; copies are never silently merged.
Privacy: Photos stay on the phone, cloud records remain owner-only, and the planner continues working without a connection after account setup.
Preserved: The complete interface rebuild, grouped navigation, segmented task filters, conflict-safe sync, and sharp haptics remain included.
